status_summary: The Universal Savings Account Act of 2025 was introduced in the Senate (S. 1581, 2025-05-01) and the House (H.R. 3186, 2025-05-05); both would create Roth-like accounts with withdrawals for any purpose and a $10,000 base contribution limit rising to a $25,000 cap, and both remain in committee. Separately, Public Law 119-21, approved 2025-07-04, lists Section 70204 on Trump accounts. Under Notice 2025-68 (released 2025-12-02), these are accounts for children under 18, with others' contributions capped at $5,000 a year, no contributions before 2026-07-04, traditional IRA treatment after 18 and no withdrawals before that year, which differs materially from the recommended accounts.
